en: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah.

zh: 大衛在猶大曠野的時候，作了這詩。

p.src: 1  God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

en: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
u.src: 1  God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

p.src: 2  So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

en: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
u.src: 2  So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

p.src: 3  Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

en: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
u.src: 3  Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

p.src: 4  So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

en: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
u.src: 4  So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

p.src: 5  My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips, 6  when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

zh: 我在床上記念你， 在夜更的時候思想你； 我的心就像飽足了骨髓肥油， 我也要以歡樂的嘴唇讚美你。
en: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
u.src: 5  My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips, 6  when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

p.src: 7  For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

en: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
u.src: 7  For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

p.src: 8  My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

en: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
u.src: 8  My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

p.src: 9  But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

en: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
u.src: 9  But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

p.src: 10  They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

en: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
u.src: 10  They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

p.src: 11  But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

en: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
u.src: 11  But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
